df<-read.csv('/data/preregSR_dataClean.csv')
# table1 discipline frame
set_table <- function(df, var_name){
  df_group <- aggregate(df$denom, by=list(df[[var_name]]), FUN=function(x)c(k_articles=length(x), n_studies=sum(x, na.rm=TRUE)))
}
print('discipline counts:')

# table 3 values
ndisclosed <- sum(df$disclosedNum, na.rm=TRUE)
cat('ndisclosed', ndisclosed, '\n')
addTable <- c('Percentage of studies with at least one outcome discrepancy that disclose an outcome discrepancy',
              'Percentage of outcome discrepancies that favored statistically significant results',
              'Likelihood ratio of a study with versus without an outcome discrepancy to contain statistically significant results',
              '*Likelihood ratio of a study with versus without a statistically significant results to contain an outcome discrepancy',
              'Likelihood ratio of a study with versus without industry funded to contain an outcome discrepancy',
              'Likelihood ratio of a prospectively registered study versus retrospectively registered study to contain a primary outcome discrepancy')
addk <- c(sum(!is.na(df$disclosedNum)), sum(!is.na(df$favorSig)), sum(!is.na(df$sigDisc)), sum(!is.na(df$sigDisc)), sum(!is.na(df$industryDisc)), sum(!is.na(df$proDisc)))
addn <- c(ndisclosed, sum(df$favorSig+df$favorNonSig, na.rm=TRUE), sum(df$sigDisc+df$sigNonDisc, na.rm=TRUE), sum(df$sigDisc+df$sigNonDisc, na.rm=TRUE), sum(df$industryDisc+df$industryNonDisc, na.rm=TRUE), sum(df$proDisc+df$proNonDisc, na.rm=TRUE))
print(data.frame(addTable, addk, addn))
